implementation_assessed: One validated synchronous WM_COMMAND to the owned Save parent/button; no second Save or fallback queued Save in the production apply path. Native normal-return receipt follows target lifetime/ownership checks.

At parent apply timeout, known exact transaction/helper ownership is installed before releasing the process fence. Helper and private transaction directory remain retained. Barrier is rechecked under the global fence before any new native helper; different raw adapters cannot bypass unresolved ownership.

While pending, raw observation continues from the existing CSV reader and does not call native status/recovery helpers. No proposal is replayed and the attempted layer remains consumed. Receipt while helper is alive cannot rearm.

Helper retirement, exact strict typed nonce/PID/HWND/power/completed receipt and normal successful helper response are validated before two full stable read-only UI/persisted audits. Power/path/non-IR parameters must match the original transaction; receipt alone is not a saved-setting or lamp-output proof.
Dedicated PersistenceVerificationTimeout distinguishes a bounded unreadable/unmatched persistence wait; explicit non-IR PersistenceMismatch does not enter recoverable pending.

Raw suspend invalidates old reconciliation stamps. Wrapper consumes a stamp once; later invalid observations retain their baseline gates. Session stamp skips only the Save-specific consumed-row wait, respects independent algorithm bounds and image holds, resets uncertain history and calculates a distinct higher row from actual settings.

Generic protocol, identity, edit-only, missing/foreign/corrupt receipt and non-IR errors remain blocked. Pending transport disposal first freezes the wrapper; global unresolved ownership survives raw disconnect and new adapter creation. Target exit without a completion proof is not automatically cleared.

Existing job chronology, same-executable/machine unique PID reconnect, retired-job/per-job watermarks, native CSV/job guards, invalid -1 handling, cap/step checks and manual image lineage retain their gates.

Updated owned Windows probe exercises 250/600/1500ms normal completion, 6500ms retained-helper completion and higher-layer Save, full observed_session recovery, and target exit without receipt. Probe changes use fixture controls for owned test processes; they do not bypass production native guards.
